cards.contentText: The unique stripes of zebras make them one of the animals most familiar to people.
cards.contentTextLong: The unique stripes of zebras make them one of the animals most familiar to people. They occur in a variety of habitats, such as grasslands, savannas, woodlands, thorny scrublands, mountains, and coastal hills. Various anthropogenic factors have had a severe impact on zebra populations, in particular hunting for skins and habitat destruction. Grévy's zebra and the mountain zebra are endangered. While plains zebras are much more plentiful, one subspecies, the quagga.

customerApp.title: Customer app
customerApp.intro: Settings of the customer loyalty app for this outlet. Everything here is off until switched on; the form sends these settings only when you change them.
customerApp.requireEmailHelp: When on, customers registering from the app or the website must give an e-mail address. Phone stays the identity.
customerApp.newProductsCategoryHelp: The menu category the app shows as New products. Pick one of this outlet's categories; clear it to show none.
customerApp.newProductsCategoryCreateHint: Create the outlet first — a category can be picked once the outlet exists.
customerApp.categoriesLoadFailed: Failed to load the outlet's categories
customerApp.announcementsEnabledHelp: When on, staff can compose announcements for this outlet (Customer App › Announcements) and the app shows the feed. When off, the feed is empty and nothing can be published or pushed.
customerApp.pushEnabledHelp: When on, a published announcement can be pushed to the customers' phones. Leave it off until the mobile app is live.
customerApp.androidChannelIdHelp: The notification channel the Android app created for announcements.
customerApp.androidChannelIdInvalid: Letters, digits, _ . - only, up to 64 characters
customerApp.senderNameHelp: Display name kept for the panel; it is not sent to phones.
customerApp.serviceAccountHelp: The key the server signs this outlet's push notifications with: the service-account JSON of the Firebase project of this outlet's mobile app (Firebase console › Project settings › Service accounts › Generate new private key). Every brand app has its own Firebase project, so upload the key of the right one — a key of another project makes every push fail with a SenderId mismatch. The key is kept on the server and never shown again.
customerApp.serviceAccountCreateHint: Save the outlet first — the service account can be uploaded once the outlet exists.
customerApp.serviceAccountNone: none — pushes end as "not configured" until a service-account JSON is uploaded

customerApp.serviceAccountRemoveFailed: The service account could not be removed

form.pinned: Pinned — shown first in the feed

settings.title: E-shop settings
settings.intro: How the web shop sells from the shops' own Winmax stock: which shops take part, which shop serves each region first, how shipping weights are read and which couriers deliver. Checkout comes in a later phase.
settings.notConfigured: This outlet has no e-shop settings yet. The values below are the defaults; saving creates its e-shop settings, switched off unless you switch the e-shop on.
settings.problemsTitle: Problems — the e-shop stays off until they are fixed:
settings.problemsRefusedTitle: Not saved — the e-shop cannot be switched on with these problems (switch it off to save the rest):
settings.noProblems: No problems found in the saved settings.
settings.checkIntro: Read-only checks of the saved settings in Winmax: document types and their warehouses, tills, warehouses, payment types and the delivery-fee article.
settings.checkIntroDirty: These checks are of the SAVED settings — unsaved changes are checked once you save them.
settings.checkProblems: The saved settings also have {n} problem(s), listed at the top of the page.
settings.discardMessage: Reload the saved settings and lose the changes made on this page?
settings.enableMessage: From the next minute Stella reads every active shop's stock from Winmax, the website shows Not Available and Low Stock, and the stock pages start working. The server refuses this while the settings have problems.
settings.disableMessage: The stock reads stop and the website goes back to how it works without the e-shop.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load the e-shop settings
toast.savedWithProblems: Saved, with {n} problem(s): the e-shop stays off until they are fixed

general.title: General
general.enabledHelp: On: Stella reads every active shop's Winmax stock every minute and the website shows Not Available or Low Stock on the products. Off: nothing of the e-shop runs.
general.checkoutHelp: On: the website takes orders through the e-shop — delivery by courier from the shops, collection from a shop, codes by e-mail — paid online by card. Off: the old checkout.
general.allowSplitHelp: On: when no single shop has everything, the order is shared between shops (a parcel from each; the customer pays one delivery fee). Off: such an order is refused.
general.testPaymentsHelp: TESTING ONLY. On: the website also offers cash, and a cash order counts as paid at once — it goes to Winmax and the couriers like a paid order. It only works on a test server (ESHOP_TEST_PAYMENTS); on a live server the switch has no effect.
general.reservationMinutesHelp: How long stock is held for a customer while paying (1 to 60).
general.tareGramsHelp: Added once to every shipment's weight.
general.shippingArticleCodeHelp: The Winmax article of the delivery-fee line (e.g. DTD125689).
general.weightHelp: Each article's weight is typed in Winmax into one of its sales prices. Missing or unbelievable weights are listed under E-shop › Weights.
general.nonStockArticleCodesHelp: Winmax article codes that never count stock or weight, separated by commas.
general.alertEmailsHelp: Who is told when something goes wrong, separated by commas.

shops.title: Shops
shops.help: The delivery zones that sell on the e-shop. Each shop sells from its own Winmax warehouse; its sales documents go to the zone's till with the zone's document type (both set under Configuration › Delivery Zones).
shops.noZoneLeft: Every zone is a shop already
shops.zoneMissing: Not a live zone of this outlet — remove it
shops.empty: No shops yet — add the delivery zones that sell on the e-shop.
shops.tillHelp: Till override: 0 sends the shop's documents to its zone's till; another number sends them to that Winmax till instead.
shops.removeMessage: Remove {name} from the e-shop? It is also taken out of every region's list. Nothing changes until you save.

regions.title: Regions
regions.help: The order in which the shops serve each region: the first shop that has everything ships the order. Inactive shops are skipped.
regions.label: Region name
regions.noShops: No shops: this region cannot be served.

districts.title: Districts
districts.help: The region that serves each district's postcodes. A district without a region is served only for the postcodes listed below. If no district has a region at all, the server uses its default map.

postcodes.title: Postcode exceptions
postcodes.help: A postcode listed here goes to its own region instead of its district's.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.help: The couriers the website offers for delivery. Their prices are the fee tables under E-shop › Courier fees.
couriers.notOnServer: This server has no courier settings yet.
couriers.acsServiceHelp: The fee table ACS is priced with: D2D unless told otherwise.
couriers.unsupportedHelp: Customers there are not offered ACS.
couriers.boxnowServiceHelp: The fee table BOX NOW is priced with: LOCKER unless told otherwise.
couriers.maxKgHelp: BOX NOW takes at most 20 kg. A heavier parcel is not offered BOX NOW.
couriers.maxValue: Most a parcel may be worth (€)
couriers.maxValueHelp: BOX NOW takes parcels worth up to €100 (POW's contract). A dearer parcel is not offered BOX NOW.
couriers.size: Locker size parcels are booked in
couriers.sizeHelp: Medium fits most parcels. A parcel that does not fit can be booked again as large.
couriers.originHelp: From POW's BOX NOW account: staff drop parcels into any BOX NOW locker. Leave empty until the account is set up (test bookings work without it).

errors.nonStock: Articles without stock: at most 500 codes of up to 40 characters each.

stock.title: E-shop stock
stock.intro: Stella keeps a copy of every shop's Winmax stock, read every minute; the website's Not Available and Low Stock come from it.
stock.neverRead: Winmax has not been read for this outlet yet.
stock.watermark: Winmax row version read up to
stock.adminOnly: Only an admin can start a read; the reads also run by themselves.
stock.incrementalDone: Changes read: {rows} row(s), {changes} status change(s), in {ms} ms.
stock.fullDone: Every row read: {rows} row(s), {zeroed} set to 0, {changes} status change(s), in {ms} ms.
stock.weightsDone: Weights read: {ok} ok, {invalid} invalid, {removed} removed, in {ms} ms.
stock.fullConfirmMessage: This reads every stock row of every shop from Winmax again. It can take a few minutes and the page waits for it. The reads of changes every minute are normally enough.
stock.lookupHelp: One article by its Winmax code: per shop, the stock in Winmax right now next to Stella's copy, with the article's web status and weight.
stock.noMenuItem: No menu item of this outlet has the code {code}.
stock.weightMissing: none in Winmax — no courier quote for this article.
stock.liveError: Winmax could not be read right now ({error}); only Stella's copy is shown.
stock.columnsHelp: Winmax now: the stock Winmax holds at this moment. Stella's copy: what the stock reads saw (amber while it has not caught up). Free to sell: the copy minus the orders from customers and the e-shop's reservations.

weights.title: E-shop weights
weights.intro: Articles whose shipping weight in Winmax is missing or cannot be right. They get no courier quote until the weight is corrected in Winmax; the next weights read picks the correction up. Vouchers and articles without stock are not counted.
weights.withStockOnly: Only items a shop can sell
weights.withStockOnlyHelp: Leaves out the articles no shop has in stock: the rest are the ones that block a courier order today.
weights.emptyMissing: No article is missing its weight.
weights.emptyInvalid: No article has an invalid weight.

reasons.NOT_A_NUMBER: The value in Winmax is not a number.
reasons.NEGATIVE: The weight in Winmax is negative.
reasons.LOOKS_LIKE_GRAMS: 100 or more in a kilogram field — grams typed instead of kilograms?
reasons.LOOKS_LIKE_KG: Under 1 in a gram field — kilograms typed instead of grams?
reasons.TOO_HEAVY: Heavier than one item may weigh (30 kg unless set otherwise).

orders.title: E-shop orders
orders.intro: The web shop's orders, newest first. Each order has one part per shop that supplies it: move each part on, step by step. An order in Exception is not sent to Winmax until an admin resolves it.

filters.attentionHelp: Needs a hand: the order is in Exception, or one of its parts is.
filters.badRange: The end date is before the start date.

orders.notEmailed: {key} at {shop} is ready for pickup, but the customer was NOT e-mailed (no e-mail address, or the e-mail failed). Tell them another way.
orders.retryNotQueued: The stock is held again, but the order could not be handed to Winmax. Check its Winmax state.

detail.noDestination: No address: a pickup or digital order.

stepHelp.Processing: The shop starts picking the items.
stepHelp.ProcessingAgain: The problem is sorted out: this part goes back to preparing.
stepHelp.ReadyForPickup: The items are packed at the shop. The customer is e-mailed that the order is ready to collect.
stepHelp.ReadyForDispatch: The parcel is packed and waits for the courier.
stepHelp.Dispatched: The courier has taken the parcel.
stepHelp.CompletedPickup: The customer has collected the order.
stepHelp.Exception: Something is wrong with this part (an item missing, a damaged parcel…). Say what went wrong. The order's other parts and its Winmax documents are not held back.

noStep.PendingPayment: No steps until the order is paid.
noStep.Exception: No steps until the order's Exception is resolved.

dialog.reasonNeeded: Say what went wrong to save this step.

exception.title: Exception: this order is not sent to Winmax until it is resolved.

codes.LATE_PAYMENT_NO_STOCK: The customer paid after the stock hold ran out, and the items were gone by then.
codes.PAID_AFTER_CANCEL: The payment arrived after the order was cancelled.
codes.HOLD_NOT_CONFIRMED: The order is paid, but its stock hold could not be confirmed.
codes.CONFIRM_FAILED: The order is paid, but an error stopped Stella from confirming its stock hold.
codes.UNVERIFIED_PAYMENT: The order was marked paid, but Stella has no verified card payment (PBT) for it.

exception.none: Nothing can be done for this order from here.
exception.adminOnly: Only an admin can resolve an Exception.
exception.retryText: Stella holds the same items again, in the same shops. If they are there, the order goes to Winmax like any paid order. If not, nothing changes: refund the customer, or wait for stock and try again.
exception.retryCheckPbt: Do this only after checking in the PBT portal that the money really arrived.
exception.refundText: First give the money back in the PBT portal. This button refunds nothing: it only closes the order in Stella (cancelled, payment refunded).

holds.title: Stock holds
holds.intro: Stock kept for e-shop orders, newest first. A hold keeps the items for the customer while they pay; once paid it stays until the order's Winmax documents take the stock. An unpaid hold goes back when its time is up.

reasons.retryLost: Another try took the stock first.
reasons.retryOrderChanged: The order changed during the try.
reasons.replaced: The customer started a new checkout.
reasons.conflict: Not enough stock of {code} when it was taken.

shipping.title: Delivery costs
shipping.intro: What customers paid for delivery against what the parcels cost POW, for paid e-shop orders that are not cancelled. A split order costs one parcel per shop while the customer pays for one: the difference is the split extra.
shipping.badRange: The end date is before the start date.
shipping.tooLong: Choose a period of at most a year.
shipping.unknownCosts: {n} courier order(s) have no known cost: they are left out of the cost and the margin.
shipping.capped: Only the first {n} orders are counted: choose a shorter period.
shipping.costHelp: Cost: what the fee tables said the couriers charge POW when the order was placed. Where a table has no cost price, the customer price is counted as the cost.
shipping.empty: No paid e-shop order in this period.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load the delivery costs

rates.title: Courier fees
rates.intro: What a parcel costs by its weight, per courier: what the customer pays and, when you type it, what the courier charges POW. The website charges the customer price; the cost price only feeds the Delivery costs report.
rates.readOnly: Only an admin can change the fee tables.
rates.noTable: No fee table yet: this courier cannot be offered until one is saved.
rates.onInSettings: {courier} is on in the e-shop settings.
rates.offInSettings: {courier} is off in the e-shop settings: customers are not offered it.
rates.serviceMismatch: The e-shop settings price {courier} with the {service} table, not this one: this table is not used until the setting says so.
rates.overflowHelp: Each started kg above the last band costs the extra amount (0: nothing heavier than the last band is taken). A parcel heavier than the heaviest is not offered this courier.
rates.prefillMessage: This replaces the ACS door-to-door table with ACS's public Cyprus price list of 1/1/2026 (VAT and fuel surcharge included, no cost prices). The table now in use is kept in its history. Replace it with POW's contract prices when you have them.

errors.perKgCustomer: Each extra kg, customer: an amount from 0 to 1000, with at most 2 decimals.
errors.perKgCost: Each extra kg, POW: empty, or an amount from 0 to 1000 with at most 2 decimals.
errors.maxKg: The heaviest parcel must be a weight in kg above 0, with at most 3 decimals (at most 1000 kg).
errors.maxBelowBand: The heaviest parcel cannot be lighter than the last band.

preview.notPriced: A {kg} kg parcel cannot go by {courier}: {reason}.

fetch.title: Fetch marketplace
fetch.intro: POW! The Shop also sells on Fetch (fetch.com.cy). Stella sends each linked Fetch store what its POW shop has free to sell in Winmax (only the numbers that changed) and, if you switch it on, the website prices. Set it up here.
fetch.notDeployed: The server does not have the Fetch functions yet (404): the backend with the Fetch feed must be deployed first.
fetch.notConfigured: This outlet has no Fetch settings yet. The values below are the defaults (dry run, switched off); saving creates them.
fetch.problemsTitle: Problems — the feed cannot be switched on until they are fixed:
fetch.problemsRefusedTitle: Not saved — the feed cannot be switched on with these problems (switch it off to save the rest):
fetch.noProblems: No problems found in the saved settings.
fetch.discardMessage: Reload the saved settings and lose the changes made on this page?

mode.label: Mode
mode.liveOffOption: Fetch live system (off on this server)

notes.dryRun: Dry run: nothing is sent to Fetch. The stores are samples (one per POW shop) and their listings are POW articles, so the whole feed can be tried before Fetch gives us keys.
notes.test: Fetch test system: stock and prices go to Fetch's sandbox stores, not to the real shops. It needs the shops' test keys below, tested — Fetch says which stores each key can use.
notes.live: Fetch live system: stock and prices go to POW's real stores on Fetch, where customers see them. Only the live server may send to it, with the live Partner ID and API key below.

mode.liveOff: Live calls to Fetch are switched off on this server, so nothing can be sent to the live system from here.
mode.notSaved: Not saved yet: until you save, the runs, Load stores and the listings stay on the saved mode ({mode}).

keys.title: Fetch keys
keys.help: Fetch gives one Partner ID and API key PER SHOP ("Credentials for POW! The Shop Nicosia Mall" …) for its test system, and new pairs for its live system later. Save each pair here and press Test: Fetch then says which stores that key can use, and the feed sends each linked store with a key that can use it. An API key is stored locked on the server and never shown again, only its last 4 characters.
keys.serverKeyMissing: This server has no FETCH_SECRET_KEY. It needs one before Fetch keys can be saved, because the API key is stored locked with it.
keys.serverKeyInvalid: This server's FETCH_SECRET_KEY is not valid (it must be base64 of exactly 32 bytes): Fetch keys cannot be saved or used until it is fixed.
keys.liveOff: Live calls to Fetch are switched off on this server: live keys cannot be saved, tested or used here — save them on the live server.
keys.sandboxOnly: This server keeps to Fetch's sandbox: a test key is used only for the sandbox stores it lists, and a key that lists other stores (a staging or live key) is refused.
keys.none: No key saved for this system yet.
keys.storesNone: Not tested yet — press Test so Fetch says which stores this key can use.
keys.label: Shop (the name Fetch gave the key)
keys.labelPlaceholder: e.g. POW! The Shop Nicosia Mall
keys.inputHelp: Partner ID and API key are needed; the shop name is for this page. A Partner ID saved again gets the new API key and must be tested again.
keys.savedNote: {label} saved. Press Test to check it with Fetch.
keys.removeMessage: The Partner ID and API key are deleted from this server. Stores only this key could use are not sent to any more.

feed.title: What is sent
feed.help: Stock goes every 2 minutes and prices every 15 minutes, and only what changed. Fetch's orders, invoices and couriers are not part of this feed.
feed.enabledHelp: The main switch. Off: nothing is sent and Fetch keeps what it last got.
feed.stockHelp: Each linked store gets what its POW shop has free to sell (website orders already taken off), and only while the Winmax stock read is fresh.
feed.pricesHelp: Off by default: the price on Fetch may need to differ from the website's (Fetch's commission).
feed.stockBufferHelp: Fetch gets the free stock minus this, never below 0. From 0 to 1000.
feed.unlimited: Articles with no stock number in any shop
feed.unlimitedHelp: These are unlimited on the website: Winmax keeps no stock number for them.

stores.title: Fetch stores
stores.help: Link each Fetch store to the POW shop whose Winmax stock it sells. At most {n} stores.
stores.label: {name} ({id})
stores.shopUnknown: A shop that is no longer in the e-shop
stores.noShops: The e-shop has no shops: set them up in E-shop › Settings first.
stores.chooseShop: Choose the POW shop whose stock this store sells.
stores.notInMode: Not among the known stores of the mode ({mode}): probably a store of another mode.
stores.removeMessage: {name} is unlinked when you save: nothing more is sent to it.
stores.noneToAdd: No other store known: press Load stores, or test the key.
stores.addHelp: The list holds the stores of the mode: Load stores asks Fetch with every saved key of the mode (a dry run gives one sample store per POW shop), and a tested key adds the stores it can use.
stores.loadSavedMode: Load stores asks Fetch in the saved mode ({saved}). Save first to see the stores of the mode picked ({mode}).

status.title: Status
status.help: What the feed last did for each saved store (mode: {mode}). The buttons work on the saved settings, for every active linked store.
status.unsavedNote: You have unsaved changes: the buttons use the saved settings until you save.
status.noneRun: No active linked store was run.
status.listingsLine: {store}: {total} listing(s) read, {matched} of them POW articles
status.notComplete: not all read: the rest next time
status.noStores: No Fetch store is linked in the saved settings.

listings.title: Fetch listings
listings.help: What a store lists on Fetch (mode: {mode}), matched to POW's articles by our code (the listing's ref) or by barcode, with what Stella last sent. The listings are read every 6 hours and with Read listings now.
listings.noStores: Link a Fetch store and save first.
listings.emptyNone: No listings read for this store yet: press Read listings now.

confirmOff.title: Stop sending to Fetch?
confirmOff.message: Nothing more is sent to Fetch. Fetch keeps the stock and prices it last got.

errors.unlimitedStock: Number to send for articles with no stock number: a whole number from 0 to 9999.
